# Introduction

## Overview
ProkaOS, is an operating system, which is developed by some young developers. Since the first day of developing, we have set up our goal: Make our own operating system, which is **simple, secure, and standalone** (3S).

Since the architecture is different from other famous OS (e.g. Windows, Linux, etc.), we made this documentation to help software developers make their software on ProkaOS easily.

This documentation is suitable for these people:

- Userspace software developer;
- Driver developer;
- Operating system developer;
- Linker developer;
- Anyone who wants to design their own architectures;
- ~~Anyone who wants to learn English~~;

and more. Due to the limit of this passage, we cannot list all of them at all.

## Highlights of ProkaOS
- **More safety**: By **separating driver and kernel**, the malicious driver will not BOOM the whole OS easily;
- **Two independent process domain**: Unlike traditional and other hobby OS, we made 2 domains/kinds of process, which is **Driver Process** (R0) and **Normal Process** (R3), so that the driver can be load dynamically;
- **More flexible**: Dynamic syscall/drvcall, without using a syscall number which you don't like, and **flexible syscall registration** allows for more efficient task processing;
- **Independent Executable Format**: Deprecating traditional PE/ELF format, we are using a new and self-designed format: **PKE**, which is much more fit for this architecture;
- **Independent bootloader**: Instead of using GRUB/limine, we switched into our own bootloader: **proka-bootloader**, which is much more simple compared with those bootloader above.
